text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while strolling around the
school
grounds at lunch...

text_block_list.name: Hasty Student
text_block_list.text:
I'm staaarviiing! I have to hurry up and
get
something to ea—agh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A student hurrying down the stairs
suddenly takes
a spectacular tumble!
This could be bad!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But in the blink of an eye, Yaeno Muteki
sweeps in like a gust of wind, catches
the falling student
in midair, and lands
as lightly as a leaf.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Your safety is paramount. Mind your
step in the
future.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This, too, I owe entirely to your
guidance,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I doubt the old me could have caught
her gently
enough to ensure we both
escaped injury.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Similarly, it was largely thanks to my
daily training that I was able to act
without hesitation.
Those sessions have
sharpened my mind.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thus, you have my heartfelt gratitude
for your
guidance! Osu!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
But I really didn't expect to improve so
much in this short period. Techniques
that were once
impossible might now be
within reach...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Care to join me for a little sparring? You
can be the recipient of my purest strike,
a technique unleashed through a
powerful body and supple, spring-like
reflexes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad that Yaeno Muteki can tell she's
making
progress. That matters more than
anything.
